title: RUE-5: Document the desktop band's new design
description: Bring the README in line with the desktop band: the three rows, the thin separate segments, no pill or marks in the Svg bar, the box bar other themes keep, the next task's color, and the new Design Source section with the Error frame named as not drawn. Sub-issue RUE-8. Files: README.md.

title: RUE-5: Lay the desktop band out in three rows
description: Move the desktop band to the Figma Desktop section's rows: the bar with the percent after it and the design's 12px between them, the dot with the ref, Progress band and the reviews open, then the task line with no leading arrow. The bar's width is what the row leaves. The percent reads 0% while tasks are made. A theme with no Svg palette keeps its box bar in the same rows. The Error frame is not covered, since nothing in the Beads data says a task failed. Sub-issue RUE-7. Files: plugins/fathom-progress/hooks/draw.tsx, desktop.ts, draw.test.ts, desktop.test.ts, draw.render.test.tsx.

title: RUE-5: Draw the desktop bar as separate thin segments
description: Replace the desktop Svg bar (16px rounded track, boundary ticks, head pill) with the Figma Desktop section's bar: one 6px fully rounded segment per task, 3px apart, in the state's color, with no ticks, pill or count. Adds the next-task color. The 12px after the bar comes with the layout task. Sub-issue RUE-6. Files: plugins/fathom-progress/hooks/desktop.ts, desktop.test.ts, plus the call site and Svg assertions in draw.tsx and draw.render.test.tsx.
